Regional lender agrees consent order over AML controls

A regional lender agreed to a consent order with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency on Tuesday, committing to overhaul its anti-money-laundering programme within 120 days.

The bank will pay a civil money penalty of $15 million and appoint an independent consultant to review its transaction monitoring, according to the order published by the regulator.

Shares fell 3% in early trading as analysts questioned whether the remediation costs would weigh on next quarter's earnings.
